literal_meaning: বরের হাতে স্থাপন করা (to place in the hands of the groom)
figurative_meaning_en: To hand over (a daughter) to the groom in marriage
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কন্যাকে পাত্রস্থ করে তিনি অনেক স্বস্তি পেলেন।
পুরনো দিনে মেয়েদের তাড়াতাড়ি পাত্রস্থ করা হতো।
example_sentences_in_english: After handing over his daughter in marriage, he felt much relieved.
In the old days, girls were married off early.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali practices of arranged marriages where parents formally entrust their daughter to the groom's family.
